headlines.title: 两部门：居民个人装入财产的离岸信托存续期间产生的收益 适用20%税率
headlines.summary: 近日，财政部、税务总局发布了《关于离岸信托征收个人所得税有关事项的公告》。财政部税政司、税务总局所得税司有关负责人就此回答了记者提问。 其中提到，对于居民个人装入财产的离岸信托存续期间产生的收益，以居民个人为纳税人，根据收益性质分别按照“财产转让所得”和“利息、股息、红利所得”，按年计算缴纳个人所得税，适用20%税率。其中，“财产转让所得”按照转让股权、股票、房产等财产收入额扣除财产原值和合理费用后的余额计算，在一个年度内的盈利和损失额可以互抵，但损失额不得结转以后年度；“利息、股息、红利所得”按照利息股息红利等其他各项所得总和计算。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: income generated during the existence of offshore trusts where individuals place their assets will be subject to a 20% tax rate.
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration recently released the 'Announcement on Matters Concerning the Collection of Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts.' Officials from both departments answered press questions. It states that for income generated during the existence of an offshore trust set up by a resident individual, the individual is the taxpayer. The income is taxed annually at a 20% rate under 'income from property transfers' or 'income from interest, dividends, and bonuses' based on its nature. 'Income from property transfers' is calculated as proceeds from transferring equity, stocks, or real estate minus the original cost and reasonable expenses, with gains and losses netted within a year but losses not carried forward. 'Income from interest, dividends, and bonuses' is based on the total of such income.

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shanghai Composite Index down 1.61%, approaching 3800 points; total market turnover less than 2 trillion yuan.

Defense stocks bucked the trend with Great Wall Military 2 limit-up, Zhongguang Leidong and Jianshe Industrial hitting limit-up. On the downside, power stocks collectively fell with Jingneng Power, Shennan Power A, Yuedian Power A, and Datang Power hitting limit-down. Nearly 5,000 stocks declined across Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen; total turnover was 1.94 trillion yuan, first below 2 trillion since April 7, 2026. Shanghai Composite closed down 1.61%, Shenzhen Component down 2.47%, ChiNext down 2.65%. 2. Only electronic specialty gases and high-bandwidth memory sectors were positive; precious metals, power, coal, and healthcare lagged. 3. Only 534 stocks rose with 42 hitting limit-up.

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就将14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单答记者问
headlines.summary: 北京时间7月23日晚，欧方正式发布第21轮对俄制裁措施，将14家中国内地和香港企业列单制裁。为维护国家安全和利益，履行防扩散等国际义务，针对欧方上述恶劣行径，根据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》等法律法规有关规定，中方决定将拉法特集团等14家欧盟实体列入出口管制管控名单，禁止出口经营者向上述实体出口两用物项，禁止境外组织和个人将原产于中华人民共和国的两用物项转移或提供给上述实体。（商务部网站）

headlines.title: 中国人寿回应减持兆易创新
headlines.summary: 中国人寿7月20日披露，该公司名下8个单一资管计划于7月8日同日卖出兆易创新约110.97万股，变现约6.82亿元，卖出均价611.46——624.61元/股。7月24日，中国人寿相关业务负责人回应称，公司的股票管理人对二级市场个股增持或减持，属于常态化投资行为，均基于投资配置需要。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: China Life responds to reducing its stake in GigaDevice.
headlines.summary_en: China Life disclosed on July 20 that eight of its single asset management plans sold about 1.1097 million shares of GigaDevice on July 8, realizing about 682 million yuan at an average price of 611.46-624.61 yuan/share. On July 24, a China Life business head responded that stock advisors buying or selling individual stocks is normal investment behavior based on allocation needs. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 两部门：由于离岸信托往往设立在信息透明度低、税负较低的国家和地区，部分个人利用其转移资产、隐匿财富及逃避税
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月24日讯，近日，财政部、税务总局发布了《关于离岸信托征收个人所得税有关事项的公告》。财政部税政司、税务总局所得税司有关负责人就此回答了记者提问。近年来，一些个人通过设立离岸信托进行财富代际传承、跨境资产配置以及风险管理。由于离岸信托往往设立在信息透明度低、税负较低的国家和地区，部分个人利用其转移资产、隐匿财富及逃避税。按照我国个人所得税法对居民全球所得征税的基本原则，《公告》明确了离岸信托设立、存续、终止清算等环节的征税规定，有利于提高税收确定性和透明度，便于纳税人合规遵从；有利于促进社会公平，维护国家权益，稳定纳税人预期。

headlines.title_en: Two departments: since offshore trusts are often set up in jurisdictions with low information transparency and low tax burdens, some individuals use them to transfer assets, hide wealth, and evade taxes.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 24: The Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration recently released the 'Announcement on Matters Concerning the Collection of Individual Income Tax on Offshore Trusts.' Officials answered press questions. In recent years, some individuals have used offshore trusts for wealth transfer, cross-border asset allocation, and risk management, often in low-transparency, low-tax jurisdictions to hide assets and evade taxes. Following the principle of taxing worldwide income for residents under China's individual income tax law, the announcement clarifies tax rules for setting up, maintaining, and terminating offshore trusts, enhancing tax certainty and transparency, encouraging compliance, promoting fairness, and protecting national interests.
